name: Gocta waterfall from Cocachimba
why: Up and down through fields and cloud forest to the foot of Gocta, a two-tier fall of over 700 m off a tan cliff, the spray reaching you long before the pool.
book: Day tours from Chachapoyas (about S/90 in 2024) include transport, guide, entry and lunch, about 09:00-17:30. You can also sleep in Cocachimba or San Pablo. Horses can be hired, but the last 30 minutes are on foot.
water: Carry 1.5-2 litres; you eat back in Cocachimba.
dangers: Mud and slippery steps in the forest, worst after rain.
Strong wind and spray at the base pool: a rain jacket, and do not swim.
Hot and humid on the climb back, out of the forest.
turnaround: Not at the falls by 13:00: turn back, the path is dark in the forest by 17:30.

points.name: Cocachimba
points.note: About 1,800 m. The visitor centre and car park of the village, with the whole waterfall in view across the valley.

points.name: La Golondrina bridge
points.note: Down through fields to the stream, then the path enters the cloud forest along the valley side.

points.name: Gocta waterfall
points.note: The pool at the foot of the lower tier, in a storm of spray. The last 30 minutes are on foot only. Back the same way, mostly uphill.
